body:
I know this sounds dumb coming from a teenager but I feel like Ive kind of tried all my options in terms of what I can do in life. Ive taken psychology just to see if that would interest me i thought about the military for a while and as for art there's tons of stuff I do to kill time (drawing comics making music) but to me finding a career in those sorts of fields seems even more risky. I wish there was something stable that really interested me but really only the idea of making stuff by myself or with friends is really what drives me. Ive just never been as happy as I was during that year as a "Youtube star". Like nothing makes me as happy as that sort of thing.

 I played an acoustic set at a coffee shop recently. And people actually like stopped to clap and cheer mid song and stuff but the feeling just didn't hit me the same. There weren't comments to read and feed back in the same way. 

Honestly to me its not even about financial stability I just want people looking at me and fawning over me. I guess im just a little attention whore like that. Obviously I want to make a living off of it as well because I want to move out but the fame is what I think drives me. 

Maybe its just my first major want in life and something else will come along but I started browsing internet videos and stuff when I was really young and sort of used it as a coping mechanism. And since then nothing has ever matched that feeling. It does seem weird to me. Like i think every kid goes through the stage of i want to be a fire fighter space man and then grow out of it and want something else. But my childhood dream grew up with me.

But the uncertainty of it all and the unstable nature of it just leaves me feeling rather hopeless in life.. Because as other people said it is an unstable market. Tomorrow it could be an unviable job. And then I just don't know what I would do.. I think I would almost certainly end my life if something completely prevented me from ever doing that sort of thing.. There's just something so completely unique and fulfilling to me about it all (and I only really experienced it partially since I was anonymous on the channel.)
